method: Ray intersection with fit-only object-origin height prior; not a universal 3D reconstruction
inputs_A: GT projected body-origin UV + calibrated camera + fit-scene median height; no heldout GT depth or Z supplied to solver
inputs_B: same + iid Gaussian 128px coordinate noise, seeds fixed; not natural detector noise
inputs_C: existing old-fold localized UV ensemble + same fit-only height prior; uses no GT keypoints or test depth
scope: C covers bowls and plate only; no masks/keypoints for remaining five objects. No model retraining; previously trained auxiliary head is not optimized for this geometric objective.
observability: One view plus unknown depth leaves a ray. Different support heights violate single-plane assumption. Fixed initial/current camera is not a calibrated stereo pair. Mesh exists but identifiable natural CAD keypoints are not established; bowl yaw symmetry is separate from depth ambiguity.
